features.title: FourPataka
features.summary: Personal Fourier music studio. Source score text owns composition; independent sound and pedal copies preserve experiments. Current app is v0.10.0. EQ/delay, chain score directives, WAV export and chord-symbol macros remain planned.

features.title: Sound and Fourier interaction
features.summary: Editable source waveform, signed harmonic sine bank and phase-continuous comparison feed independent audio processing paths.

features.title: Sine-bank synthesis and voices
features.summary: Sixteen signed harmonics and optional undertones retain absolute amplitude. Oscillator replacements preserve the original voice phase; envelopes and a 32-voice cap bound playback. Monitor volume stays outside saved mix settings.

features.title: Waveform drawing and control points
features.summary: Draw or place dots on an odd waveform half-cycle. Shape-preserving cubic interpolation avoids overshoot; projection produces signed sine coefficients. Reset restores a sine while preserving envelope and trim.

features.title: Continuous A/B comparison and scheduling
features.summary: A/B changes keep the musical clock and active envelopes. Phrase clipping preserves chords/rests. Stable source buses and warmed aligned pedal branches avoid silence gaps. Score comparison temporarily overrides only the selected track; Stop/replay restores saved copies.

features.title: Pedalboard and processing
features.summary: Compressor/overdrive chains have independent audition A/B, track and master instances. The flat three-band EQ model/audio factory is implemented; its pedal controls are being added. Serial cables follow pedal order. Circular dials, exact inputs and sliders share parameter updates; each drag is one undo step. Score parameters freeze until replay, while bypass remains live. Delay/tails and score through/master directives remain unimplemented.

features.title: Composition studio
features.summary: Line-oriented score text is authoritative. Parallel tracks start together; the compiled timeline and transport use the frozen playing revision. Text edits take effect on replay.

features.title: Score parsing and editor
features.summary: Source offsets map diagnostics, explicit notes/chords/rests and track assignments back to text. Shared command metadata supplies reference cards. Autocomplete is optional. Chord-symbol macros with hover/focus expansion remain later work; unsupported pedal directives diagnose rather than being ignored.

features.title: Tempo, meter and timeline
features.summary: Tempo always counts quarter notes. Project meters support 1–32 over 1/2/4/8/16; 6/8 spans three quarter beats. Partial bars and crossing notes are valid. Timing edits preserve comments and form one undo step; invalid or playing scores guard those controls.

features.title: Track creation and assignment
features.summary: Track maker validates note/chord/rest rows, reorders with buttons and previews length in project meter. Source-aware instrument assignment loads an independent preset copy while preserving track level and pedals.

features.title: Project state and desktop studio
features.summary: Versioned local project data, musical undo and sandboxed desktop workflows support personal use. Preferences stay separate from imported projects.

features.title: Independent copies, persistence and undo
features.summary: Project schema v1 retains source text and deep-copied applied sounds/chains. Library edits never overwrite track instances. Validation preserves the current project on failed import. Grouped edits retain one undo entry per waveform stroke or rotary gesture.

features.title: Themes and responsive layout
features.summary: Instrument, Pedalboard and Compose are primary views; Learn is secondary. Five bundled themes use secondary/tertiary accents and contrast-adapted ink. Theme changes preserve playback and musical undo.

features.title: Electron application and native files
features.summary: Sandboxed renderer with no Node access loads local assets via a private protocol. A narrow preload bridge handles native JSON dialogs and menu actions. Portable Windows builds bundle assets; hidden isolated profiles support native tests.

features.title: Maintained project knowledge
features.summary: Tree-sitter code links, source-linked docs/plans, feature and dependency summaries, local embedding seeds and personalized PageRank produce bounded context. Refresh hashes after changes and maintain behavioral summaries alongside implementation.
